A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] '''Scavenger''' operated sometime in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and was composed of a number of [[R-41 Starchaser]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The squadron was tasked with accompanying the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Muurian transport|transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'' on its mission to retrieve a [[Damaged Viper probe droid|damaged]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] located near the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]]. However, all [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the squadron were destroyed by the [[Azzameen family]] [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', manned by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]], in a standoff over the retrieval of the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe]].

==History==
The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] operated in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="XWA" /><ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and comprised six [[R-41 Starchaser]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]],<ref name="XWA" /> which acted as escorts for larger craft.<ref name="XWAPrima">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Sometime after a [[Battle of Hospital|battle]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at an [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|Alliance hospital]] [[XQ2 Platform|platform]], the squadron accompanied the [[Muurian transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'', a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], on a [[Mission to the Saila Na system|mission]] to retrieve an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] that had been [[Damaged Viper probe droid|stranded]] near the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]]. However, the ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', a [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] flown by Alliance [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and his [[MK-series maintenance droid|droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]], [[MK-09/Legends|MK-09]], entered the [[Star system/Legends|system]] with the same mission objectives.<ref name="XWA" />

Several of the R-41 Starchasers, which the ''Otana'' identified under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Scavenger, broke formation to engage the intruding [[Light freighter/Legends|freighter]]. Two stayed with the [[Muurian Interstellar|Muurian]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]], which was trying to escape with the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] [[Predator I|pod]].<ref name="XWA" /> Before the ''Pelican'' could leave the system, though, Azzameen obliterated the starship and much of Scavenger. With only one R-41 Starchaser remaining, the final starfighter attempted an escape with the probe, but MK-09, controlling the ''Otana''{{'s}} [[Turret/Legends|turret]] [[Laser cannon/Legends|cannons]], destroyed the R-41 before it could do so.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> With Scavenger defeated, the ''Otana'' collected the pod and left the sector.<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The squadron first appeared in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', though neither the game nor its [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|guide]] give it a name beyond the ''Otana''{{'s}} designation of Scavenger. In the game, the squadron serves to challenge the player on a simple pickup mission. It is possible to complete the mission without destroying the ''Pelican'' or any escorting craft.<ref name="XWA" /> However, the squadron's destruction is confirmed via an [[in-universe]] retelling of the events by MK-09 in the Prima strategy guide.<ref name="XWAPrima" />
